A '''village''' existed during the [[Legacy era]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuthard]]. By the time a group of people interviewed an old [[Unidentified Dimok crone|crone]] there, it had been half bombed, courtesy of the [[Sepan Civil War]].
